title: Mack used Grof's holotropic breathwork to help abductees recall their experiences

tellings.quote: then Mack would use that in his practice with a lot of the um the abductees in order for them to recall their experiences.

plain: In the 1990s, the Harvard psychiatrist John Mack, who worked with people who said they had been taken by aliens, is said to have used holotropic breathwork to help them recall what happened. Holotropic breathwork is a method of fast, deep breathing meant to bring on altered states of mind, developed by the psychiatrist Stanislav Grof. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and it would mean the abductees' memories came partly through an altered state.
